I team-teach a course on medical imaging and related topics designed for a broad audience. It's mainly aimed at biology graduate students, but students from any major are welcome to enroll.

## Description

It is mainly delivered by with [Prof. Chengyan Wang](https://hupi.fudan.edu.cn/d3/cb/c53324a775115/page.htm). I will be giving lectures on ultrasound imaging and its clinical applications on the following date.

This course takes place in Room 302 in the Second Teaching Building of the Fudan Zhangjiang campus every Thursday afternoon (15:20–17:05) during the first semester of the 2026–2027 academic year.
